{{Quote|Borvo likes your spirit, Sykes. He offers you a place by his side.''"<br />"''I don't take bribes. Now set down.|Adela Tyché and Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
This '''attack''' occurred after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were in desperate need of allies. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the Security Forces had joined together with [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who betrayed them and [[Search for Captain Kael|killed]] Kael. The Hutt planned to sell as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo civilians]] that Kael and Sykes had previously [[Liberation of enslavement camps|rescued]] from the Federation. Sykes and fellow [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Vedd Deviss]] and [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], flying [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], split up and pursued the Hutt to his base on [[Porso Hill]]. Deviss saw the Hutt heading to Porso Hill and informed Sykes, who moved ahead and began his attack. After fighting through opposing [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|starfighters]], Sykes joined with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kol Kotha]], who led the Naboo pilot to Porso Hill but withdrew after receiving damage to his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Sykes engaged the Hutt's [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|personal transport]] while his newly-arrived [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] provided cover and forced the Hutt to flee.

==Prelude==
The alliance between the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> had proven fruitful. The Naboo resistance fighters were able to mount an [[Attack on disabled base|offensive attack]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and with Borvo's help, they [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberated]] Trade Federation [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps. However, Borvo kept the alliance only as long as he could profit from it; he eventually betrayed the resistance, killing the [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] leader, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]], and taking the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to sell as slaves. As a result, he gained the ire of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], who was driven to avenge his captain and rescue his people. Sykes and two [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]], [[Vedd Deviss]] and [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], flying [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]], located the Hutt on [[Porso Hill]] and flew to stop him.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The battle==
===Infiltration===
{{Quote|Lieutenant Sykes, cease your approach! We will open fire.''"<br />"''Your boss killed my captain and enslaved my people. He will be brought to justice.|One of Borvo's mercenaries and Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
As Sykes approached Borvo's location on Porso Hill, he was hailed by one of the [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|Hutt's starfighters]], warning him to stay away, but Sykes refused to comply with the demand. The Hutt's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] subsequently attacked him, and he shot them down while avoiding their fire and that from [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]]. After Sykes eliminated that threat, he destroyed a wall of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] blocking his path. [[Kol Kotha]], one of the Hutt's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and Sykes' former wingmate, approached directly in front of Sykes, asking the Naboo pilot not to fire on him in order to give him the chance to explain that he wanted to help. Sykes cautiously accepted his help, telling Kotha to lead him to the Hutt. The two flew onward, taking fire from more turrets. Kotha led Sykes to the Hutt but had to retreat, having suffered damage to his starfighter and a weapons malfunction.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Along the way, Sykes spotted homing [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] technology that could potentially be used by the [[Naboo Resistance|Naboo resistance]]. Blowing away the surrounding [[Tree/Legends|trees]], he was able to acquire the valuable technology.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

===Porso Hill===
{{Quote|Uh, Lieutenant, we're out of torpedoes. You're going to have to make the run.|Bravo Squadron pilot Vedd Deviss|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:Bfn_porso_hill_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lieutenant Sykes destroys Hutt starfighters.]]
As Sykes flew in to meet the Hutt, Borvo launched his [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|freighter]]. [[Adela Tyché]], the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] pilot, contacted Sykes and translated Borvo's words, which was to offer the Naboo pilot a bribe to join Borvo. When Sykes refused, the rest of the Hutt fighters launched to defend the freighter as Deviss and Hollis arrived to reinforce Sykes. Sykes ordered them to attack the freighter while he provided cover, but the two were out of torpedoes. Sykes instead proceeded to attack the freighter himself while the other pilots provided cover. Despite fire from turrets, Sykes delivered heavy damage to Borvo's ship; as it exploded, the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] separated, sending Borvo and Tyché flying away in retreat.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Nice work, Naboo boy. You saved your people, and Borvo is limping back to Nal Hutta.|Kol Kotha, to Gavyn Sykes, at the conclusion of the attack|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
When Borvo fled in the freighter's cockpit, the remaining Hutt pilots ran with it and the Naboo pilots cut off the chase. Kotha rejoined the Naboo pilots and congratulated Sykes on sending Borvo back to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the Hutt's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. With this threat gone, Sykes wanted to return to fighting the Federation, but he felt that the Resistance needed more pilots. Kotha mentioned that, while serving Borvo, he had [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] Trade Federation camps which the pilots could liberate, and the quartet went on to achieve that [[Liberation of Camp Four|objective]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. Hidden in the level is the Homing Torpedo upgrade; picking it up fulfills the bonus objective. The ending cinematic reflects how many Hutt starfighters are seen fleeing with Borvo, depending on how many are shot down in the second part of the level.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
